inputs.name: indent.lines
inputs.description: Source lines to prefix with the requested two-space indentation; an empty list produces no rows.

inputs.name: indent.depth
inputs.description: Number of two-space indentation levels to add before each line; it defaults to one for nested sections.

inputs.name: fields.list
inputs.description: Contract fields to render as names, types and qualifiers, with descriptions continued on indented lines; an empty list renders as none.

inputs.name: fields.componentProps
inputs.description: When true, shorten names to their final dotted segment and collapse duplicate props; false preserves qualified names when needed to distinguish fields.

inputs.name: errorRows.errors
inputs.description: Declared error fields to format; when empty, the status determines whether output says none or unknown.

examples.name: renderUnit.detail
examples.description: The detail has an unsupported shape.

inputs.name: errorRows.status
inputs.description: Declared contract error outcome, used to distinguish declared absence, unknown indirect errors and statically found or not-found errors.

inputs.name: operationRows.operations
inputs.description: Operations whose names and Inputs, Outputs and Errors sections are rendered in order.

inputs.name: storageRows.models
inputs.description: Storage models whose table, primary key, fields, validation, relations and unresolved gaps are rendered.

inputs.name: renderContract.manifest
inputs.description: Unit manifest whose contract is rendered; component manifests use props while other units may show storage, initialization and operation sections.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Example identifier.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Rendered summary.

inputs.name: groupTests.tests
inputs.description: Test file paths to group by containing directory; an empty list renders as none.

inputs.name: renderUnit.detail
inputs.description: Unit manifest, revision hashes, consumers and test files used to render the complete Markdown unit detail.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Example identifier.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Rendered summary.

outputs.name: indent
outputs.description: Lines prefixed with two spaces repeated for the requested depth, preserving their order.

outputs.name: fields
outputs.description: Formatted field rows with required/default qualifiers and each field description on its own indented line; empty inputs render as none.

outputs.name: errorRows
outputs.description: Formatted error fields, or a status-specific none/unknown row when there are no errors.
examples: The detail has an unsupported shape.

outputs.name: operationRows
outputs.description: Operation names followed by indented Inputs, Outputs and Errors sections.

outputs.name: storageRows
outputs.description: Storage model rows including schema declarations and any recorded unresolved schema details.

outputs.name: renderContract
outputs.description: Contract heading and the sections applicable to this manifest's kind and declared contract.

outputs.name: groupTests
outputs.description: File count and per-directory counts, or none when no tests are listed.

outputs.name: renderUnit
outputs.description: Markdown unit summary combining its title, responsibility, contract, runtime, revision, relations and impacted tests.
